A failed request precondition must return 412 Precondition Failed.

What the Standard says

RFC 9110 defines 412 when one or more request-header preconditions evaluate to false on the server. Read section 15.5.13.

Why it matters

Using 412 distinguishes stale ETags and other failed conditional requests from general state conflicts, allowing clients to refresh and retry safely.

Bad code example

catch (OrderPreconditionException)
{
    return Conflict();
}

Good code example

catch (OrderPreconditionException)
{
    return StatusCode(statusCode: 412);
}
